newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: China's Fujian refinery delays restart to end May.
newsitem.headline: China's Fujian refinery delays restart to end May.

text.p: China's southeastern Fujian Refinery has delayed the restart of its 80,000-barrel-per-day crude unit by two week to end of May, a company source said on Monday.
"We hoped to restart this week, but some works haven't been finished," the source said by telephone from Fujian.
"The works take longer than expected because we are doing expansion at the same time," the source said.
After the refinery restarts, its annual capacity would be raised to four million tonnes (80,000 barrel-per-day) from 2.5 million (51,000-bpd), the source said.
The refinery delayed its original maintenance turnaround to late April from early April.
The company has said it would boost its annual capacity to 12 million tonnes by the year 2000.
